title_vi: Phát hiện nút hỏng trong hệ thống phân tán: sáu biến thể của nhịp tim

claims.claim_vi: The source names six heartbeat variants: push-based, pull-based, with health check, with timestamps, with acknowledgement, with quorum.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit; only the names and order are used.

claims.claim_vi: Simulated (author's model, not a measurement): one heartbeat per second, network delay 20 ms plus an exponential of mean 80 ms, 1% of beats delayed a further 0.5 to 2 s; over 2,000,000 beats (about 556 h) a gap threshold of 1.5 s gave about 38 false suspicions per hour, 2 s about 12.5 per hour, 3 s 2 in the whole run, 5 s none.
claims.verified_by: Computed by the author with Python (random, seed 1); the code is not stored, the model is written in the lesson.

claims.claim_vi: In an asynchronous network a slow node cannot be told from a failed one from outside, so failure detection yields suspicion, not certainty.
claims.verified_by: General knowledge of the author, not checked against an official document: the writing environment could only reach GitHub, and no official document for this topic is hosted there.

design_notes_vi: Hai khung ghi chú: ai chủ động, và cách làm cho nhịp đáng tin hơn.
source_deviations: Source lists six variants; the lesson keeps names and order, groups them in two sets and adds a simulated experiment on choosing the timeout.
The simulation is the author's assumed model and is labelled as such in the lesson.
